reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Orthopnea/PND point to left-sided congestion rather than peripheral or drug edema

reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Drug-induced edema mimics HF and resolves with withdrawal

reference_targets_freetext.item: Pitting edema depth and extension to the sacrum
reference_targets_freetext.rationale: Dependent, symmetric pitting distribution supports systemic congestion over venous insufficiency
